Operator Varkáris has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for swift and fierce enemy suppression in combat.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Guard Operator during field operations to exercise Centurion responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.

description.en:
The sky isn't dark yet, but he begins to set up camp. There is no need to rush, he tells himself.
He has resigned from his ferryman job, even though the citizens of Athenius voted to have him stay. With his apprentice gone, he no longer has any time-sensitive responsibilities on his shoulders.
This freedom terrifies him and he knows it: he's slowing down. Compared to when he left his homeland five years ago, the land seems no different now—desolate and quiet. The clearly depicted river on the tattered map in his hand was gone without a trace.
The priest said that snowmelt will eventually form new rivers, but all he sees now is desolation.
An indistinct fear creeps into his heart once more, an emotion he has long been acquainted with. Ever since he embarked on this journey home, when he arrived in Athenius with Ithakos's blood-soaked robes and stayed after the priest invited him to, he had been caught in its clutches. It was the fear that kept him there with no way to return home, that had him unleash his rage and hatred upon the Sargonians. What can he even do if he goes home and realizes the past is gone forever? What else can he chase after?
By now the sky is completely dark. He lowers his oar and retrieves the lantern hanging on it. Old and riddled with signs of wear, yet it follows him everywhere. It used to be an ordinary oil lamp, but Ithakos had modified it to run on Originium and added a windproof case designed with latches that could be easily opened for a soft light to guide him home. He still remembers that night. He was adding notes to the river map based on his observations, as Ithakos hammered away on his workbench nearby to improve the lantern.
Finally, he works up a slight smile as he carefully wipes the dirt off the lantern and tries to open the case—but fails to.
It is stuck. This has never happened before. He dares not use force, nor does he know how to repair it, so he can only gently turn it over. Cold sweat forms beneath his mask and on his back as fear returns. After leaving Ithakos's armor and Arts Unit to the guerillas and leaving his bloody chiton to Athenius, this is the last item he owns with any connection to him. If he loses even this, then what should he—
Click.
The lantern opens up.
A thin fiber falls out of it.
He breathes a sigh of relief as he raises the lantern to the river map. After a long silence, he remembers to look at the fiber, surprising himself when he realizes it is the top of a reed. Perhaps the wind blew it over the night before, or in the morning, and he only now noticed its presence.
Just as he only now realizes how soft the black earth is beneath him—though the rivers have yet to return, the annelids in the soil were already weaving through the ground in his absence, and the reeds of the rivers and marshes are once again regaining their moisture.
At daybreak he can go even further, he thinks.
description.zh:
天色还没有暗透，但他已开始准备露营。没必要再赶路了，他对自己说。
他已辞去了摆渡人的工作，尽管雅赛努斯的公民们投票决定让他留下。徒弟也离开了，如今已不再有任何事需要他按时按点去做。
这种自由让他惶恐，他知道，自己正越走越慢。大地似乎与五年前他离开故乡时没有任何变化，荒凉，寂静，他手中那张软烂的地图上清晰画着的河道，在他眼前全无踪迹。
祭司说，高山的积雪总会融化，新的河流总会出现，但他目之所及之处却只有荒芜。
隐约的恐惧又在他心头涌起，这种情绪已伴随他很久。自他踏上这条回家的路以来，甚至，自他带着伊萨科斯的血衣抵达雅赛努斯、祭司邀请他留下的时候，他就已经被它攥住了。是这份恐惧让他留下，让他无法回到故乡，让他将愤怒与恨倾泻在萨尔贡人身上——他一直在害怕，如果他回到故乡，发现再也回不到从前，那他还能再做什么？他还能再追寻什么？
天彻底暗了。他放下手中的桨，去取挂在桨上的提灯。这盏提灯已经很旧了，布满使用的痕迹，但他一直随身带着。它原本只是一盏普通的油灯，是伊萨科斯帮他做了改造，将它改成源石驱动，又做了防风的护壳——这是非常精巧的设计，上下两部分护壳间有卡扣，只要轻轻提起，就能将护壳打开，让提灯露出柔和的光芒，照亮他回家的路。他还记得那天的情景，当时他在饭桌边给手中的河道图添加自己观测水文后的注释，伊萨科斯就在不远处的工作台上做着改造，制造出一些叮叮当当的动静。
他终于露出了一丝微笑，小心地擦了擦提灯上沾到的土，想要拉开提灯的护壳——但是没能拉开。
护壳卡住了。这是以前从未发生过的事。他不敢用力硬拔，也不知该如何修理，只能尝试轻轻地转动提灯。冷汗在他的面具下、在他的背上浮起，他又开始害怕了。在他将伊萨科斯的护甲和施术单元留给游击队，将伊萨科斯的血衣留给雅赛努斯之后，这已是他所拥有的与伊萨科斯相关的最后一件物品，假如连它都失去，那他今后该——
咔哒。
提灯打开了。
一片薄薄的纤维掉了下来。
他松了口气，将提灯放到河道图旁，在寂静中呆坐许久之后，才想起来查看那一小片纤维。他惊讶地发现，那竟然是芦苇的冠毛。或许是在前一夜，也可能是在这天的早上，风将芦苇送到了他身边，而他一直没有注意到这一点。
就像他现在才意识到，脚下黑色的土地是松软的，在他离开的这些年里，虽然河流还没有回来，但土壤中的环节动物已开始翻动土地，属于河流和沼地的芦苇已经感受到了湿润的气息。
天亮之后，可以再多赶些路。他想。
